verdict.rationale: Morph documents a first-party `service_tier: "standby"` option at half price that is explicitly "built for batch and background workloads", so the discount versus real-time pricing is clearly documented. However, standby is a deprioritized synchronous request tier that sheds a fast 429 when a region is busy instead of queuing work, not an asynchronous batch-job API where you submit jobs and collect results later. Missing for 10: async batch job submission/polling/result retrieval, queued (not shed) execution guarantees, independent or hands-on corroboration of the standby discount.
